knowledge_point.title: Classifying a System as Consistent Dependent, Consistent Independent, or Inconsistent

question.:question/problem:
Consider the following system of equations.

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x+2y &=0 \\ x+4y &=4\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Which of the following statements are true?

Select all that apply.
question.:question/worked-solution:
To classify the system, we first need to find its solution. The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & 0 \\ 1 & 4 & 4\end{bmatrix}.
$$

Using the method of Gaussian elimination, we can reduce this matrix to row echelon form as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & 0 \\ 1 & 4 & 4\end{bmatrix} & {R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-1){R}_{1} \\ & ∼\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 4\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

There is a pivot for each variable and no contradictory row. The system has a unique solution, so we conclude that the system is consistent independent.

As a result, only statement “The system is consistent independent” is true.

question.:question/problem:
Consider the following system of equations.

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x+2y-2z &=-4 \\ x+3y &=-8 \\ x+y-4z &=-3\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Which of the following statements are true?

Select all that apply.
question.:question/worked-solution:
To classify the system, we first need to find its solution. The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -2 & -4 \\ 1 & 3 & 0 & -8 \\ 1 & 1 & -4 & -3\end{bmatrix}.
$$

Using the method of Gaussian elimination, we can reduce this matrix to row echelon form as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -2 & -4 \\ 1 & 3 & 0 & -8 \\ 1 & 1 & -4 & -3\end{bmatrix} & {R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-1){R}_{1} \\ & ∼\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -2 & -4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -4 \\ 1 & 1 & -4 & -3\end{bmatrix} & {R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+(-1){R}_{1} \\ & ∼\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -2 & -4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -4 \\ 0 & -1 & -2 & 1\end{bmatrix} & {R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+(1){R}_{2} \\ & ∼\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -2 & -4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -4 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -3\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

The final row corresponds to the equation $0x+0y+0z=-3,$ and this has no solution. Therefore, our system has no solution, and we conclude that the system is inconsistent.

As a result, only statement “The system is inconsistent” is true.
